question: Has the 26 February 2020 approval for the Chief Minister's Helpline been changed by a later GR?
gold_answer: No newer GR found in this corpus (covers 2018 to 2024)

gold_grs_detail.title: Administrative approval for the Implementation of Hon. Chief Minister Helpline, in the State of Maharashtra.

product.answer: No newer GR found in this corpus (covers 2018 to 2024) that amends, replaces, stays, extends, or clarifies the 26 February 2020 approval for the Chief Minister's Helpline. The newer-GR candidate 201907311131241311 is unrelated to this approval. I couldn't find a later GR changing that specific approval.

cited.title: Administrative approval for the Implementation of Hon. Chief Minister Helpline, in the State of Maharashtra.
cited.quote: नागरिकांना शासनाच्या विविध कल्याणकारी योजना / प्रकल्प, शासनाकडून देण्यात येणाऱ्या सेवा इत्यादींची माहिती, तसेच नागरिकांच्या तक्रारी शासनापर्यत पोहचविण्याकरीता एकात्मिक नागरीक संपर्क केंद्र - मुख्यमंत्री हेल्पलाईन ही एकच दूरध्वनी क्रमांक असलेला प्रकल्प राबविण्याचा प्रस्ताव शासनाच्या विचाराधीन होता.

product.answer: No newer GR found in this corpus (covers 2018 to 2024) that changes the 26 February 2020 administrative approval for the Chief Minister's Helpline. The retrieved GR from 26-02-2020 itself grants the administrative approval for integrating citizen contact with a single telephone number for the Chief Minister's Helpline, approving 80 seats for three years at a per-seat monthly cost of Rs. 21,462 plus GST and toll-free number expenses totaling Rs. 6,83,26,560 excluding GST.
